board.name: Indiana Physician Assistant Committee and Medical Licensing Board of Indiana, Indiana Professional Licensing Agency

ce.categoryRules: No state hour count or category split. Renewal requires evidence of current NCCPA certification; NCCPA's own CME rules then apply.
ce.controlledSubstanceCe: None. The 2 hour opioid prescribing and opioid abuse CE tied to the Indiana controlled substance registration (IC 35-48-3-3.5) expired 1 July 2025.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Written collaborative agreement submitted to the Board before practice begins (on employer letterhead, signed by PA and physician); every amendment is resubmitted; the physician registers intent to collaborate; PA or physician notifies the Board and Committee within 15 days when a collaboration ends. No fixed renewal interval for the agreement.
practice.notes: Chart review within 10 business days: at least 10% of charts with a prescription in the first year of prescribing authority, then a percentage set in the agreement. A physician may collaborate with no more than 4 PAs at the same time. PAs on Inactive status need not keep NCCPA certification.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Prescriptive authority is requested with the licence application or later through a Change or Add Collaborator request, and must appear in the collaborative agreement; controlled substances also need an Indiana CSR and DEA registration.

board.name: Indiana State Board of Nursing, Indiana Professional Licensing Agency

rn.notes: No CE for RN renewal. Indiana is a Nurse Licensure Compact state (IC 25-42); a multistate licence adds a $25 fee.

aprn.title: APRN Prescriptive Authority (or APRN - Compact RN); NPs who do not prescribe practise on the RN licence
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: No separate NP practice licence. The 'APRN' credential is prescriptive authority only; it requires an active Indiana RN licence (or a home-state multistate RN licence for the APRN - Compact RN version).
aprn.renewalDeadline: 31 October of each odd-numbered year (APRN - Compact RN follows the home-state compact RN expiry)
aprn.ceRules: Applies to holders of prescriptive authority: 30 contact hours in the 2 years before renewal including 8 pharmacology, from a nationally approved nursing CE sponsor. First renewal is prorated: granted less than 12 months before expiry, none; 12 months or more, 15 hours including 4 pharmacology. Random audit of at least some licensees every 2 years.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Yes. APRN Prescriptive Authority is its own credential from the Board of Nursing, renewed every 2 years with the RN licence.
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: None. The 2 hour opioid CE for the CSR expired 1 July 2025.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: All APRNs (except CRNAs) must operate in collaboration with a licensed practitioner evidenced by a practice agreement, or under hospital privileges (IC 25-23-1-19.4(c)). A written collaborative practice agreement filed with the Board is required for prescriptive authority (848 IAC 5-2-1); a current signed and dated agreement is submitted with each prescriptive authority renewal, and collaborator changes are reported to the Board. The agreement must require the APRN to send prescribing documentation to the practitioner within 7 days, including at least a 5% random chart sample (848 IAC 5-1-1).
